title: 第十四章 最危险的地方就是最安全的地方

content_zh:
看着抱头蹲防的少女，方正一时间也不知道该说什么才好，他略微思考了一下，最后无奈的叹了口气伸出手去，毕竟总不能够就这样看着她一直蹲在地上吧。
“你没事吧？”
“啊………”
听到方正的声音，那个少女再次颤抖了一下身体，随后她小心翼翼的望向方正伸来的手，犹豫了片刻之后，这才战战兢兢的伸出手去握住对方，然后被方正拉着站起身来。
“非，非常抱歉，让您见笑了………”
“不，没什么…………”
“那，那么………请稍等………”
深呼吸了口气，少女重新戴上了兜帽，这似乎让她原本紧张的心情放松了许多，只见少女再次来到书架前，然后拿出了一本厚重的书籍放在桌子上摊开，她拿起旁边的羽毛笔，对着水晶球虚画了一笔什么，随后方正就看见在水晶球里一股奇妙的湛蓝色的力量从中浮现，然后在少女手中羽毛笔的指引下落在了那本书里，接着在那原本空白的纸面上浮现出了一个奇特而神秘的符号。它的外形是一个十字星的形状，最外围还有一个圆圈，上面有一圈看起来类似甲骨文一样的奇异文字。只不过方正看不懂上面写的是什么，他在记忆中得知这是这个世界所谓的“星辰之语”，传闻是秩序女神创造世界时为了稳定这个世界，而为每一颗星星赋予了它们专有的含义，但是这种语言除了神明之外，没有人可以解读。
“荒芜之境………重现之星………”
少女低声自语了一句，甚至连方正都没听懂她在说什么，不过很快少女就合起了自己手中这本大书。然后从抽屉里拿出了一枚银色的徽章放在自己的面前，她再次举起羽毛笔，对着水晶球点了点，很快，又一股相同的力量从中被抽出，然后被吸入了那枚银色徽章里。随后，少女面前的水晶球再次黯淡了下来。
“好了，这位先生，请您收好这枚徽章，它已经收取了您的星纹。”
不知道是不是因为自己的真面目曝光的原因，这会儿少女的声音也不再是刚才那种伪装出来的低沉，而是一种非常悦耳的声音。不过方正一听也就明白为什么对方会故意给自己装出那么一个样子了，实在是这个少女的本来声音真是一点儿威慑力都没有，不管怎么听都好像是在软绵绵的哀求一般。
虽然这么一个声音配合少女那可爱的样貌怎么看都像是卖萌的最佳人选，但是作为一个政府工作人员，她这个样子明显是不足以用来镇场子的。
“谢谢。”
一面说着，方正一面拿过那枚徽章，接着他闭上眼睛，将自己的力量注入徽章之中，很快，方正眼前就浮现出了一片漆黑的星空，其中有一大片的星星闪闪发光，而在正中央的星辰，则是最耀眼的那颗。
这就是自己的命运星辰了，不过………
方正对比了一下记忆之中原本属于威廉姆斯的星纹，随后满意的点了点头。虽然他不是星象学家，更完全看不懂星图，但如果只是单纯比较两张星图不同的话方正还是能够做到的。很明显，这两颗星辰位于完全不同的位置，至少在方正来看，双方并没有什么相同之处。
那么，可以继续了。
想到这里，方正微微一笑，收起了徽章，接着他再次望向眼前的少女。
“这位小姐，我有一个小小的请求。”

“什么请求？”
听到方正的询问，少女好奇的歪了歪脑袋，接着她似乎意识到了什么般，急忙摆了摆手。
“那，那个，老师说我不能随便出去和陌生男人吃饭………”
“…………………”
虽然方正很想说这位小姐你真的想多了，但是转念一想，要不是自己身上没有这些麻烦事，说不定他还真会顺手邀请对方去吃个饭什么的………不过算了，这种事以后再说。
“是这样的………”
方正咳嗽了一声，把这些古怪的念头扔到脑后。
“我想要去圣殿一趟，希望你能够为我出具一封信函。”
“圣殿？信函？”
听到方正的说话，少女愣了一下，随后这才反应了过来。
“先生您是打算加入圣殿吗？”
“是的。”
听到这里，方正总算松了口气，心想这位小姐虽然看起来迷糊，但好歹总还是个正常人。一般人想要进入圣殿祈祷肯定是不需要什么信函的，而方正去圣殿，自然不是为了向秩序女神祈祷宽恕，又或者参观名胜古迹。而就是字面上的意思，他要加入圣殿。

content_en:
Looking at the girl holding her head and squatting in defense, Fang Zheng didn't know what to say for a moment. He thought for a moment, and finally sighed helplessly and stretched out his hand. After all, he couldn't just watch her squatting on the ground like this.
"Are you okay?"
"Ah..."
Hearing Fang Zheng's voice, the girl trembled again. Then she carefully looked at Fang Zheng's outstretched hand. After hesitating for a moment, she cautiously stretched out her hand to hold the other person's hand, and then was pulled by Fang Zheng to stand up.
"No, I'm very sorry for making you laugh..."
"No, it's nothing..."
"Then, then...please wait..."
After taking a deep breath, the girl put her hood back on, which seemed to relax her nervousness a lot. The girl came to the bookshelf again, then took out a heavy book and spread it on the table. She picked up the quill next to her and drew something on the crystal ball. Then Fang Zheng saw a strange blue power emerge from the crystal ball, and then fell into the book under the guidance of the quill in the girl's hand. Then a strange and mysterious symbol appeared on the originally blank paper. Its shape is the shape of a cross star, with a circle on the outermost edge, and a circle of strange words that look like oracle bones on it. However, Fang Zheng couldn't understand what was written on it. He learned from his memory that this was the so-called "Language of the Stars" in this world. It was rumored that the goddess of order gave each star its own meaning in order to stabilize the world when she created it. However, no one except the gods can interpret this language.
"The Desolate Realm...the Reappearance of the Star..."
The girl whispered to herself, and even Fang Zheng didn't understand what she was saying, but soon the girl closed the big book in her hand. Then she took out a silver badge from the drawer and placed it in front of her. She raised the quill again and pointed at the crystal ball. Soon, the same power was drawn out of it, and then was sucked into the silver badge. Then, the crystal ball in front of the girl dimmed again.
"Okay, sir, please keep this badge. It has already collected your star pattern."
I don't know if it's because her true identity was exposed, but now the girl's voice is no longer the deep one she pretended to have just now, but a very pleasant voice. However, once Fangzheng heard it, he understood why the other party deliberately pretended to be like that for him. In fact, the girl's original voice was really not intimidating at all. No matter how it sounded, it seemed like she was softly pleading.
Although such a voice combined with the girl's cute appearance seems to be the best candidate for being cute, but as a government worker, her appearance is obviously not enough to control the scene.
"Thank you."
As he spoke, Fang Zheng took the badge, then he closed his eyes and poured his power into the badge. Soon, a dark starry sky appeared in front of Fang Zheng's eyes, with a large number of stars shining brightly, and the star in the center was the most dazzling one.
This is your own destiny star, but...
Fang Zheng compared the star pattern that originally belonged to Williams in his memory, and then nodded with satisfaction. Although he is not an astrologer and cannot understand star charts at all, Fang Zheng can still do it if he simply compares the differences between the two star charts. Obviously, the two stars are in completely different positions. At least from Fangzheng's point of view, there is nothing similar between the two stars.
Then, you can continue.
Thinking of this, Fang Zheng smiled slightly, put away the badge, and then looked at the girl in front of him again.
"Miss, I have a small request."
"What request?"Hearing Fang Zheng's question, the girl tilted her head curiously, and then she seemed to realize something and waved her hand hurriedly.
"Well, well, the teacher said I can't just go out to eat with strange men..."
"………………"
Although Fang Zheng wanted to say that this young lady, you really think too much, but then he thought, if he didn't have such troubles, he might actually invite the other party to have a meal or something... But forget it, let's talk about this kind of thing later.
"That's it..."
Fang Zheng coughed and threw these weird thoughts to the back of his mind.
"I want to go to the temple and I hope you can issue a letter for me."
"Temple? Letter?"
Hearing Fang Zheng's words, the girl was stunned for a moment, and then she came to her senses.
"Sir, are you planning to join the Temple?"
"Yes."
After hearing this, Fang Zheng finally breathed a sigh of relief, thinking that although this young lady looked confused, she was still a normal person. Most people would definitely not need any letters if they wanted to enter the temple to pray, but Fang Zheng went to the temple not to pray for forgiveness to the goddess of order, or to visit historical sites. And that literally means, he's going to join the temple.
